parameters.frequent: Fehler at position 0 and each position divisible by 100 in every document
parameters.rare: Verbindung at the last position of doc00.txt only

timer: time.perf_counter_ns; elapsed_ns retains integer block duration
cache: warm: corpus initially read and verified; repeated loading with 5 warmups in final; OS cache not cleared

timing_boundaries.load: complete load_corpus including traversal, sorting, byte read and UTF-8 decode; block_size=1
timing_boundaries.preparation: complete prepare_corpus including validation, document sorting, normalization and tokenization; block_size=1
timing_boundaries.build: not applicable for direct search; CSV blank
timing_boundaries.query: public search_direct_word on prepared corpus; query normalization, sequential token comparisons, complete sorted unique result included
timing_boundaries.blocks: query blocks retain 10 full result lists; block loop and list allocation overhead included identically per query
timing_boundaries.excluded: expectation checks, counting, metadata, plotting, disk output and printing outside intervals

statistics: median and inclusive quartiles via statistics.quantiles(n=4, method='inclusive'); IQR=q3-q1
memory: not measured; index_bytes and peak_memory_bytes CSV fields blank
background_load: Keine parallelen Messungen, Agenten oder Builds; Videopipeline pausiert; Lastmittel vor Start 1.24 3.56 5.23
dataset_order: generated 10000,100000,1000000 then real BGB; query order shuffled deterministically for each warmup and measured repetition
real_corpus: BGB (daten/real/bgb/dokumente, 2486 paragraphs, one document each); delivered series 01_direkte_suche used the Kafka excerpt
